@fieldLanguage.description: Settings field choosing the language of the app's interface.

@languageSystem.description: Language option: follow the languages set in macOS.

permAccessibilityNote: Needed for hotkeys and to paste text
micDenied: Denied; allow it in System Settings
micAsk: macOS asks on the first recording
permGlobeNote: In Keyboard, set “Press 🌐 key to” to “Do Nothing”
timeoutNote: After this, the raw transcript is pasted.
rememberNote: Start translations in the language last picked on the voice bar.
switchLanguageTooltip: Click to switch the target language
noteSilent: No sound came in; check the microphone permission
noteRawPasted: Cleanup failed; pasted the raw transcript
noteNoKey: Add your OpenRouter API key in Settings first
notePasteFailed: Couldn't paste; the text is on the clipboard: {error}
notePasteNeedsAccessibility: Couldn't paste without Accessibility; the text is on the clipboard
shortcutSwitch: Switch the target language while translating
dictionaryNote: Names and terms here are spelled exactly as written.
fieldShowTimings: Show timings on the voice bar
showTimingsNote: After each dictation, how long transcription and cleanup took.
asrServiceNote: Soniox transcribes while you speak; OpenRouter once you stop.
sonioxKeyNote: Create one at console.soniox.com. Stored in the Keychain.
sonioxLanguagesNote: Codes of the languages you speak, such as zh, en.
asrFallbackNote: Used when Soniox can’t be reached.
openRouterKeyNote: For cleanup, translation and backup transcription. Stored in the Keychain.
noteStreamFallback: Soniox wasn’t available; transcribed with OpenRouter
whileRecordingNote: Keeps music and videos out of the text; it comes back when you stop.
saveHistoryNote: Text only, never audio. Keeps the latest 1,000.
clearHistoryMessage: This deletes the saved text from this Mac. You can’t undo it.
historyEmpty: Nothing yet. What you dictate or translate shows here.

@historyUsage.description: Entries kept and the space they take, under the history switch.

providersNote: Tried first, in order. Empty lets OpenRouter choose.
cancelNote: While recording, transcribing or cleaning up.
translateNote: Speak any language; the text comes out translated. Fn finishes.
targetsTabNote: Tab cycles through the languages ticked below while translating.
